result.detail: After the counterfactual and metric-shape fixes, the full run at revision f11c429a1fa75e9f passed all five suites with the counterfactual passing at graph level. On held-out target-disease links the static logistic arm had the highest macro AUPRC, the enriched arm was slightly worse, and the pruned arm lost substantial signal; the heuristic is identical for static and enriched because it only reads target-disease edges.
